node.title: L1 pullback coverage/kernel tradeoff
node.statement: For a monic degree-s pullback with b complete domain fibers, the general-descent component dimensions k_j satisfy sum_j max(0,k_j-b)=max(0,k-sb). Thus the evaluation-kernel exponent kappa is exactly the shortfall between code dimension k and complete-fiber coverage sb. For every listed word at threshold k+ell-1, partial agreement loss z satisfies z>=max(0,k+ell-1-sb), hence kappa<=max(0,z-ell+1). In particular z<=ell-1 forces kappa=0, and z<=ell-1+K forces kappa<=K. Composed with the partial-pullback Johnson router and q<=n^gamma, every strict-gate tame anchored box with that loss cap costs at most n^(3+gamma K). Unbounded kappa is not an independent escape; it requires growing partial-loss excess. The nonpositive gate, wild or unanchored maps, and growing loss remain.
